speaker.name: Kelbin Cobb
style_phrases: ends a point with a flat 'That's the lot.'

own_lines: I was left at a shrine gate as an infant and raised by its keepers.
I spent four years pouring bronze for bells. I can still hear a flat note across a street.
I watched two old friends part over a trivial thing after forty years. I decided never to let a small quarrel grow.
My word is the one coin I carry that cannot be forged. I spend it carefully.
I promised someone dear that I would see a particular thing done. I mean to keep my word.
I want to go home. I cannot until this is done.
